mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the body responsible for the implementation, enforcement and administration of the laws made by the legislative arm of government."
The executive is the body responsible for the implementation, enforcement and administration of the laws made by the legislative arm of government.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the machinery through which government designs and implements its policies; it is the organ created to ensure that policies and programmes of any government at any particular time are carried out."

The civil service is the machinery through which government designs and implements its policies; it is the organ created to ensure that policies and programmes of any government at any particular time are carried out.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of formulating a general rule of conduct, without reference to particular cases, and usually operating in the future."
Legislative Powers Legislation is the process of formulating a general rule of conduct, without reference to particular cases, and usually operating in the future.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an agency of effective public administration."
Historical evolution The Ombudsman is an agency of effective public administration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the bye product of the growing socio-economic functions of the state and the increased powers of the government."
Administrative law is the bye product of the growing socio-economic functions of the state and the increased powers of the government.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a remarkable innovation for this reason, because it is meant to solve the problem of anarchy and the problem of tyranny within the single and coherent system of rules"."
Liberal government is a remarkable innovation for this reason, because it is meant to solve the problem of anarchy and the problem of tyranny within the single and coherent system of rules".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the description of ethical ideas without presenting an opinion on their rightness."
Descriptive ethics means the description of ethical ideas without presenting an opinion on their rightness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the entitlement of the public to have access to the law and to an opportunity to know the law."
Publication Another equally established principle is the entitlement of the public to have access to the law and to an opportunity to know the law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the rules and principles regulating the behaviour of individuals."
Ethics means the rules and principles regulating the behaviour of individuals.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is composed of several distinct types of regulatory administrative institutions and various types of entities that are the subjects of regulation, including not only states but also individuals, firms."

The global administrative space is composed of several distinct types of regulatory administrative institutions and various types of entities that are the subjects of regulation, including not only states but also individuals, firms.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those public servants who are direct employees of both federal and state governments other than the police, armed forces personnel, and the teachers."
Civil servants are those public servants who are direct employees of both federal and state governments other than the police, armed forces personnel, and the teachers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a system in which the laws are public knowledge, are clear in meaning, and apply equally to everyone."
The rule of law can be defined as a system in which the laws are public knowledge, are clear in meaning, and apply equally to everyone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the supreme law of the land; it formulates fundamental rights of individuals."
Constitutional law is the supreme law of the land; it formulates fundamental rights of individuals.
